about.heroTitle: गुणवत्तापूर्ण NEET तैयारी को सभी के लिए किफायती बनाना
about.heroSubtitle: हम तमिलनाडु के government-school, state-board और rural students को NEET की तैयारी में मदद करते हैं - और जरूरत पड़ने पर विदेश में medical seats के रास्ते समझाते हैं.
about.mission: Cost और language को NEET preparation की बाधा न बनने देना, ताकि हर serious aspirant practice, progress measure और improve कर सके.
about.vision: ऐसा भविष्य जहां student का district, board या family income doctor बनने की संभावना तय न करे.
story: SIVORA UP↑RISING एक simple observation से शुरू हुआ: कई capable students को realistic practice नहीं मिलती क्योंकि coaching और test series महंगी और mostly English में होती हैं.
हमने affordable, mobile-first, bilingual platform बनाया जहां mock tests clear chapter-level feedback के साथ मिलते हैं.
जो students मेहनत के बावजूद India में seat miss करते हैं, उनके लिए हमारी admission guidance team विदेश में recognised universities के regulated रास्ते समझाती है.

help.heroSubtitle: Register, test खरीदना, test देना, results पढ़ना और admission team तक पहुंचना - simple step-by-step guides.

sections.title: 1. Create your account
sections.intro: You only need your profile details and mobile number to start.
steps: Tap “Register” on the home page.
Enter your name, email, mobile number, location, school, class, board, and preferred language.
Enter the 6-digit OTP sent to your mobile by SMS.
Your account is ready — you are taken to your dashboard.
sections.shot: The registration form with profile, school, and language fields.

sections.title: 2. Buy a mock test for ₹30
sections.intro: Every test costs just ₹30. Pay with UPI, card, or net banking.
steps: Open “Mock Tests” from the menu.
Use the filters or search box to find a test (by subject, chapter, year, or type).
Tap a test to see its syllabus, duration, and number of questions.
Tap “Buy ₹30” and complete the payment.
The test unlocks instantly and a payment confirmation appears.
sections.shot: A test card showing the ₹30 price and the Buy button.

sections.title: 3. Take a test
sections.intro: Your answers save automatically, even on a slow connection.
steps: Open a purchased test and tap “Start”.
Choose the language you want to attempt the test in.
Read each question and tap your chosen option (A, B, C, or D).
Use “Mark for Review” to flag questions to revisit.
Move between questions with Next/Previous or the question grid.
Tap “Submit” when done — the test also submits automatically when the timer ends.
sections.shot: The test screen with a question, options, timer, and question grid.

sections.title: 4. Read your results
sections.intro: See exactly where you are strong and where to improve.
steps: Your result opens as soon as you submit.
See your score and the count of correct, wrong, and skipped questions.
Check the subject and chapter analysis to spot strong and weak topics.
Review every question with the correct answer and explanation.
Download your result as a PDF to keep or share.
Open “Performance” to track your progress across all tests.
sections.shot: The result page with score, subject bars, and chapter analysis.

sections.title: 5. Contact admission guidance
sections.intro: Explore MBBS abroad and let our team guide you — for free.
steps: Open “Admission Guidance” from the menu.
Read about the study destinations, cost, and eligibility.
Fill the short form with your NEET score and preferred country.
Submit the form — our counselling team will contact you.
Track your request status on the same page any time.
sections.shot: The admission guidance form with score and country fields.
